title: Escape The Ghosts
description:
You start at `(0, 0)` and want to reach `target`. On each turn, you and every ghost may independently move one unit north, east, south, or west, or stay still. All moves happen simultaneously. You escape only if you reach the target before any ghost reaches you. If a ghost reaches the same square as you on the same turn, you are caught. Return true if you can reach the target without capture regardless of how the ghosts move; otherwise return false.

## Examples

```text
Input: ghosts = [[1, 0], [0, 3]], target = [0, 1]
Output: true
```

```text
Input: ghosts = [[1, 0]], target = [2, 0]
Output: false
```

```text
Input: ghosts = [[2, 0]], target = [1, 0]
Output: false
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= ghosts.length <= 100`
- `ghosts[i]` and `target` each contain two coordinates.
- Every coordinate is in `[-10^4, 10^4]`.
- Multiple ghosts may share a location.
